contracts: `/countries` publishes only active countries with listed public-name indicators having nonzero facts; empty-signal dev fallback uses raw listed counts; RU added from active listed macro plus number of RegionIndicator definitions, not indicator×region pairs

Country catalogue uses strict state-Redis generation, durable mirror, build lock and stale grace; stale gets no-store, verified current gets public max-age60/s-maxage300; 503 on unverifiable generation

Concept compare uses curated dataset/measure and explicit national crosswalk with Russia bridge; map/snapshot benchmark median for HICP/GDP concepts, unweighted average for others, only when enough countries

summary: Прогноз территории использует новый v4 cache namespace для однолетней годовой политики.
contracts: Country must be active and have installed subnational passport; indicator must be listed and country-matched; region must be country-matched

Hub lists all regions and listed indicators, config labels/default/map ID; profile lists all listed indicators with latest/previous points and per-indicator ranks except provider bea-regional; series includes same-period rank, national counterpart when national_code set, siblings and expanded source URL

Map period resolves requested period to nearest available not later if possible, but falls back to latest when all available dates are later/invalid; ranking uses better_is_low ascending else descending and excludes null values
All responses locale-keyed and versioned world cache 15m, except forecast 24h; forecast endpoint invokes state_forecast from raw regional series on cache miss
Актуализация по main 972579f: Прогноз территории использует новый v4 cache namespace для однолетней годовой политики.
side_effects: forecast computation/service calls potentially model state writes depending service implementation
errors: 404 inactive/unsupported country, unknown region/unlisted indicator/no data; malformed period falls back to latest, not 400
Country/indicator match enforced in helpers but `national_code` points to globally unique WorldIndicator.code without separate country check
doc_corrections: Map period is best-effort nearest available; profile ranks omit bea-regional but detail rank can still query one chosen series.
